correctness.rationale: Every connected allocation has exactly one hub bundle and singleton leaves. Enumerating a connected two-way repartition by its isolated leaf proves the exact PMMS inversion criterion, zero-hub exceptional equality, binomial counts, and PMMS/leximin equivalence. Boundaries r=0, r=k, zero and tied valuations are included. The standalone standard-library enumeration agrees on 83,309 settings and 1,391,766 center-subset choices; the finite checks corroborate rather than substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification and exact count of fair connected allocations, not merely an existence proof or restatement of leximin=>PMMS. It identifies all permitted zero-hub exceptional allocations and sharp discontinuous prevalence, enabling exact counting/sampling and local-versus-global fairness comparisons across a meaningful infinite parametric family.
